concept: Marble Top: Kyani & Co., Marine Lines (1904). The camera works top-down over one marble table. A chequered tablecloth wipes between scenes, a ceiling fan spin opens the room, a bun is split and butter melts in, a mawa cake is sliced to show its crumb, handwritten bill lines write themselves in the founder-era ink. Food named, no prices.

alternatives.name: Marble Top
alternatives.note: chosen: top-down tabletop, chequered wipe, fan spin

alternatives.name: Handwritten Ledger Walk
alternatives.note: rejected: too close to the receipt/ledger device used in the Acquisition Lore film

alternatives.name: Mirror Hall
alternatives.note: the cafe's big mirrors as scene frames, reflections swap scenes

dimensions.palette: ink #121316, marble white #F1F4F6, Irani red #D0344A (no orange, no cream)
dimensions.fonts: Fraunces variable (weight pulse) + DM Mono labels, two faces only
dimensions.opening: cafe name first: big 'Kyani & Co.' lockup in frame 1 under a ceiling-fan spin, then the 3D Mumbai map dive. No Bombay Cafe Map logo in scene 1 (L051, supersedes L037)
dimensions.camera: map dive to Marine Lines, then locked top-down dolly over the marble table
dimensions.layout: top-down table scenes, one hero dish per scene, left-weighted headlines
dimensions.texture: marble veining, enamel plates, 3D extruded OSM buildings with detail pass
dimensions.sound: fan hum, plate clink, knife on bun, pen scratch, soft pad, voice at most 2.2 words per second
dimensions.ending: hard cut to the large Bombay Cafe Map lockup with @bombaycafemap and bombaycafemap.com, Kyani & Co. as a smaller line, held 3 s

experiment.hypothesis: Headline weight swelling on each spoken beat ties type to the voice without extra motion.

render_engine: raea if the install check passes, else the HTML + Playwright pipeline
